pcs.pc_description: collate the design requirements in terms of dimension, final weight of metal and gemstone, process metal loss and finishing allowance, assembly sequence of components, etc. from the internal team in the form of hand sketches, coral draw sketches, a knockdown jewellery piece, clowning sample, etc.
report any issues related to design concept clarity, dimensions and practicality to CAD manager
determine the various design and Computer- Aided Manufacturing (CAM) related parameters at various stages of manufacturing in consultation with the CAD manager
set the required unit and dimension parameters in the CAD file
insert sketches, scanned images, diagrams, signs or symbols, etc. of required jewellery design in a CAD file
create 3D jewellery CAD design using appropriate curve commands such as line, arc, solid commands such as box, etc. present in the menu.
use a library like the Bermark library, Stuller findings library of preloaded and editable completed pieces, components like shank, ring settings, clamps and findings like chains etc.
use basic and advanced transformed tools like scale and orient, flow, array, move, edit, etc.
create designs with rail, profile tools, smart targets and image trace, etc.
create Signet, Award and Eternity rings using various builder tools
use production tools like object checker, ring resizer, metal weights, mesh repair, 3D printing etc.
use advanced surface making tools like T- Splines, T-Splines HUD, etc.,

use various gem placing basic and advanced commands like Gem loader, Gem springs, Gem on curve Multi, Auto pave builder, Halo builder, etc. in the Gems menu to load, replace, and control the layout of one or more gems at a time

use single or multiple diamond and gem setting tools like Head builder, Bezel builder, Prong builder, Prong on the surface, etc. from setting menu to create heads, bezels, under the bezel, and prongs around gems that have already placed in the model
create free-form shapes or designs like filigree, vines, scrollwork, flowers, etc. using clayoo, organic 3D-modeling tools
create voids in solid objects for azures, channels and popular setting styles like bright-cut and fishtail, using creating cutters menu for single or multiple stones cutter, Boolean Builder, etc.
use relief sculpting or art tools for designing embossed or engraved text or shapes over coins, medallions or family crests
create photo-realistic renders and animations quickly and easily using Render menu commands like Vray styles, Render Editor, props library etc., various light and Animation commands too

use appropriate shrinkage and stone setting parameters for making seat and hole for diamond, for making prongs of particular thickness and height, for the gap between prongs, for the gap between diamonds etc.
prepare a drawing of different views of 3D jewellery design using different projection methods like orthographic, perspective, etc. in different positions and angles
apply different colours for the stone in different sizes in the drawing

prepare notes related to design in terms of overall dimensions or other manufacturing specifications like assembly sequence, surface texturing, Customer specific dimensional tolerances, stamping instructions etc. in the drawing
maintain CAD files using advanced content manager or project manager tools, backup of CAD files and records of other related information shared by internal team or customer
report any issues while working with CAD file using to CAD manager
check each CAD design for the final look and various design parameters before final submission
rework as per the CAD manager’s feedback when required, based on inputs from marketing, merchandising, product development and production department
ensure timely delivery of 3D jewellery design file or STL (stereolithography) or OBJ (object), etc. files converted from the CAD designs to enable the commencement of prototyping process
create 3D jewellery CAD designs as per target given
update the CAD manager on work completion status

modules.module_title: Preparation of Build and STL (Standard Triangle Language) file

pcs.pc_description: convert the solid or surface 3D model created using various CAD software and in different file format like SLC (export slice file) to STL format using appropriate software or plugin
identify the errors in the STL file like gaps or missing facets, degenerate facets, non-manifold condition, and flipped triangles etc.

fix these errors to get a watertight model of proper thickness and volume model using appropriate software and different repairing commands like separating shells, closing holes, bridging gaps, resolving overlaps and intersections, stitching, double faces, remeshing, etc.
export the repaired STL models to build preparation software
orient the individual STL models to appropriate position and angle using various commands such as translate, rotate, duplicate, Z compensate etc. on the build platform
create support for the STL models
inspect the build file for wall thickness, platform bounds, collision detection etc.
create the slice data or file of the complete build and transfer on 3D printers or rapid prototyping machines for part building

modules.module_title: Producing wax or wax mix resin-based prototype using 3D printers

pcs.pc_description: upload the sliced build or platform file on the 3D printer
check and set various parameters like resin level in the vat, resin homogeneity, platform clamping, room temperature and humidity etc.,
start the machine and check prototype or part building at regular intervals
remove the platform from clamps and allow resin to drain before part removal

modules.module_title: Cleaning and curing of printed resin or wax parts

pcs.pc_description: remove the supports from the resin parts using tweezers
clean resin parts in Isopropyl alcohol or acetone solution and dry with compressed air
clean the wax parts using boiling water in case of wax-based support material and dry with compressed air
put the resin part for curing in UV light chamber for appropriate duration
finish the surface of resin part using emery paper or by sandblasting
inspect the parts thoroughly by comparing with the 3D model file before sending for rubber mould cutting or casting process or dispatch
report supervisor in case of any issue during file fixing, part building, cleaning or curing process
organize the work station, machine and tools
ensure timely delivery of parts to enable the commencement of rubber mould cutting or casting process or dispatch
print the number of parts per day as per target given
update the supervisor on the work completion status at the end of shift
